nodes.label: scanner service

nodes.label: api service
nodes.details: build ./backend; port ${API_PORT:-8001}:8000; DATABASE_URL (asyncpg), REDIS_URL, CORS_ORIGINS, IPAMBOX_* auth vars, SCAN_* guard vars, BACKUP_* vars; /healthz healthcheck

nodes.label: web service (pinned 192.0.2.10)
nodes.details: build ./frontend with NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL build arg; port ${WEB_PORT:-3010}:3000
nodes.rationale: Pinned at ipv4_address 192.0.2.10 so IPAMBOX_TRUSTED_PROXIES on the api can trust exactly this peer for X-Forwarded-For — nothing else on the bridge can spoof it.

nodes.label: db service (postgres:16-alpine)

nodes.label: redis service (redis:7-alpine)

nodes.label: API_BIND publish binding
nodes.rationale: The API is published on ALL interfaces by default (deliberate LAN access to /docs, /metrics and scripts); API_BIND=127.0.0.1 restricts it to loopback (web UI only).

nodes.label: IPAMBOX_COOKIE_SECURE env
nodes.rationale: false so logins work over plain HTTP on a LAN (browsers reject Secure cookies on non-localhost http origins); set true when serving HTTPS.

nodes.label: ipam bridge network 192.0.2.0/24
nodes.rationale: 192.0.2.0/24 is RFC 5737 TEST-NET-1 — reserved for documentation, so it can never collide with a real LAN/WAN client; changing it requires updating IPAMBOX_TRUSTED_PROXIES and web's ipv4_address together.

nodes.label: DB/Redis loopback-only port publishing
nodes.rationale: Postgres (127.0.0.1:5432) and Redis (127.0.0.1:${REDIS_PORT:-6378}) publish on loopback only — bound to loopback while still reachable from the host-networked scanner container.

nodes.label: SCAN_MAX_HOSTS env
nodes.rationale: Scan guards live in the API (validation/rate-limit); the worker reads them too — set on both api and scanner with default 4096.

nodes.label: scanner network_mode: host + NET_ADMIN/NET_RAW
nodes.rationale: Host networking gives the worker real L2 access for ARP scanning; it reaches Postgres/Redis via the loopback-published ports.

nodes.label: IPAMBOX_TRUSTED_PROXIES env
nodes.rationale: X-Forwarded-For is honored only from these peers — 192.0.2.10 is web's pinned address on the ipam bridge; keep in sync with services.web.networks; uvicorn gets the same list via --forwarded-allow-ips.

nodes.label: uvicorn --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips
nodes.rationale: Uvicorn is launched with --proxy-headers and --forwarded-allow-ips $IPAMBOX_TRUSTED_PROXIES so the app sees the forwarded client IP only from trusted peers.
